metin: Inside a quiet car driving on a forest road, soft engine hum, tires on asphalt, light wind, no music, no voices
Misty lake shore in a pine forest at early morning, gentle birdsong, distant ducks quacking softly, light water lapping, no music, no voices
A flock of ducks suddenly taking off from a lake, loud wing flapping, water splashes and panicked quacks, no voices
A person slipping on wet muddy grass and falling on their bottom, squelch and soft thud, cartoon comedy timing, no voices
Two sharp taps of a wooden cane on a wooden pier followed by one short shrill metal whistle blow, no voices
Many ducks swimming calmly toward the shore in a line, soft paddling water sounds and gentle content quacks, no voices
Peaceful lakeside cafe terrace, tea glass clinking on a saucer, soft breeze through leaves, distant birds, no music, no voices
Calm lake at sunset, gentle water lapping against a wooden pier, crickets starting, a distant soft duck quack, no music, no voices
